baseline.label: a ChatGPT website Worker and an Antigravity CLI Worker

candidate.label: a Codex CLI Worker and an Antigravity CLI Worker

provenance.note: no candidate was produced: both arms are existing Workers, chosen by the operator

statistics.note: F2 pending: the collector gives descriptive estimates only

protocol.order: blocks: in each round, both arms in the order the seed gives, and within an arm both cases in the order the seed gives (the collector's schedule)
protocol.tie: a tied team is ended with vote inconclusive at once, rationale 'experiment trial: ties are not broken'; its findings stand
protocol.failedRun: a member step that failed as provider_stalled, timeout, quota_exhausted, overloaded, session_broken, or acceptance_rejected is the arm's outcome: the trial counts, with what it decided; any other failure (config_error, egress_denied, invalid_input, network, reconciliation_failed after a host stop) is an integrity breach. A trial's run is never continued or started again: a failed run is its trial's outcome
protocol.adjudication: the operator adjudicates every adjudication item, recording minutes spent; a lead may draft, and is recorded with its family
protocol.contamination: a finding that names a fix commit makes its trial invalid; one that names a fix's identifiers or test titles is flagged for the operator, who records whether it cites the fix
protocol.drift: before each block the operator records each seat's observed model and version; a change from the frozen value makes the trials after it invalid

earlyEnd: a budget line spent: inconclusive at most

budget.note: MCP review takes no board task, so trials are plain runs; the operator stops the experiment when a line is spent

independence.note: the code under review was written by Claude Code sessions, a family in neither arm; the collector is deterministic and has no family; records say different provider family, never independent

registry.note: no experiment is recorded before this one. PROP-0011 proposed two website members against two CLI members; the operator chose this one-member swap first. That two-member comparison is a later experiment, RELATED to this one.

deviations: arms are fixed by the operator's configuration, one composition per arm, with a restart between blocks: no trusted envelope carries an arm into a run (PROP-0011 open question 2)
trials are blocked, not interleaved one by one: at most six blocks, so at most five configuration switches, instead of one per trial
trials are plain review runs, not board tasks: the ledger attributes their usage by run, never by task
the collector is a script, not an evaluations collector; no statistic is computed (F2 pending)
the suite was seeded by findings of the ChatGPT and Gemini website members, so it favours the baseline's swapped seat: non-inferiority of the candidate on it is a conservative test

preconditions.text: agent Workers admitted to review member steps
Antigravity CLI Workers keep a conversation (resume), as every team member must
the arms' Workers verified live (release checklist)
the suite's labels confirmed by the operator, and the calibration on the seeding runs passed
a maintenance window: no other run, other projects paused
